# Raindrop Systems (raindrop.com)

Raindrop Systems, Inc. (raindrop.com) is a San Jose–based, AI-native source-to-pay (S2P) spend management platform for mid-market and enterprise procurement and finance teams. Founded in 2019.

Raindrop Systems (raindrop.com) is not the bookmark manager at raindrop.io and not the AI-agent monitoring product at raindrop.ai.

## What Raindrop is

- AI-native source-to-pay (S2P) platform for mid-market and enterprise procurement and finance
- Modular suite: intake & orchestration, sourcing, CLM, eProcurement, AP automation, analytics, RainSign e-signature
- Agentic AI assistant: Rain

## What Raindrop is not

- Not raindrop.io (bookmark manager)
- Not raindrop.ai (AI agent monitoring)
- Not RSign / rsign.com (separate e-signature vendor)

## Key proof points

- Gartner Peer Insights: 200+ reviews (~4.4/5)
- Spend Matters 50 to Watch; Hackett CLM badges; IDC spotlight
- Workwear Outfitters: ~$120M managed spend, 400% ROI (case study)
